cnidae.m: More than one cnida. cnida: a nematocyst.

cnidoblast.m: A cell in the epidermis of cnidarians in which the nematocyst develops.

cnidoblasts.m: More than one cnidoblast. cnidoblast: a cell in the epidermis of cnidarians in which the nematocyst develops.

cnidocil.m: The fine hairlike trigger of a cnidoblast.

cnidocils.m: More than one cnidocil. cnidocil: the fine hairlike trigger of a cnidoblast.
